topology_reasoning.device: four-port waveguide crossing / compact star-coupler-like intersection
evidence: The black material is one connected component inside a 4.7 um by 4.7 um square footprint.
There are four equal-width access waveguides entering from north, south, east, and west.
Each access guide broadens into a lens-shaped taper before overlapping at a central multimode intersection.
The layout is mirror-symmetric horizontally and vertically.
topology_reasoning.working_principle: Single-mode access guides adiabatically expand into a wider central multimode aperture. The central overlap supports the crossing/scattering region, and matched flares on all four sides preserve symmetry so the intended ports see the same impedance transition.
function_defining_knobs: guide_width_um controls the single-mode port width.
flare_width_um controls the multimode aperture at the crossing.
flare_length_um controls taper adiabaticity and the footprint occupied by each lobe.
delta_length is a symmetry/phase trim exposed for evaluator knob-response verification by extending one guide length.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitive model: four elliptical flare primitives plus four rectangular access guides; stopped because IoU >= 0.85.

implementation_note: Initial GDSFactory import repeatedly stalled in this pane before writing GDS; final script uses gdstk primitive rectangle/ellipse constructors with the same top-level parametric knobs and no external hints.
